subject: A long-lens satellite photograph from orbit, straight down, of a wide empty plain between two worn-down ranges on a dun and red world: red ground over pale sand, a dry creek line marked by lone dark trees, low outcrops of pale rock. Nothing made by people. Grainy, high contrast, like a spy-satellite frame.
card: setup.site, the two sites from orbit (sitesHTML in js/ui.js)
notes: Barrens, the barren world (never the graveyard world). Drawn small, as a 16:9 frame with a reticle over it, so it must read as a photograph from orbit.
